subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is genuinely impressed by Zalthir's combat roll and believes perhaps he has been approaching his own training the wrong way.
source_quote: He was, by every available indication, genuinely impressed. Apparently no one had hit him that hard in a long time. He stood there for a moment, something recalibrating behind his blindness, and said — almost to himself: "Perhaps I've been approaching this the wrong way."

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir finds the official manual aggravating and ignored it, building something better in spite of it.
source_quote: Zalthir found the manual aggravating, ignored it, and built something better.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers a moment from the Underdark where he punched through the shadows themselves with surgical precision.
source_quote: Zalthir recalled something from the Underdark — a moment where he'd found a way to punch *through* the shadows themselves, precise as a surgical cut.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir acknowledges that Khell-Vire is right about him remembering the shadow monks who drove him nuts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin refuses to refer to Dawnbringer as a mere specimen and insists she is his friend.
source_quote: What do you mean, specimen? This is my friend Dawnbringer.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is uncertain about Dawnbringer’s pronoun and has been struggling with it since Waterdeep.
source_quote: I don't know what to call her, but, you know, whether it's them? Is it her? He, her? I don't know what to call them, but, you know, it's like — we've gotten to know each other pretty well over, you know, the last stressful ordeals.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin feels relieved when Philemon acknowledges the bond between him and Dawnbringer, even though he wasn’t told to expect that.
source_quote: That landed somewhere I hadn't expected. I hadn't been told to be relieved by that. I was anyway.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin understands the impulse behind his joke about the rebound relationship because it’s a habit he developed to cope with unbearable specificity.
source_quote: I understood the impulse behind the joke. The giants who raised me had a saying that translated roughly as: the ground under a joker is the same ground everyone else is standing on. You laugh when the weight gets too specific to name. I'd been doing it since Velkynvelve.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes Dawnbringer needs to remember what daylight feels like without needing to fight, and later to grieve.
source_quote: Your sword — she needs to remember what daylight feels like without needing to fight. And then, when she's ready, and you are willing, she needs to grieve.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin reflects that the healing they did in Waterdeep was real but didn't close everything.
source_quote: That was real. But happy doesn't close everything.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin hopes Dawnbringer will grow a plus one, as a lighter note after heavy experiences.
source_quote: We're all gonna grow out of this," I said. "Hopefully, Dawnbringer grows a plus one."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has a persistent headache since arriving at Candlekeep and suspects it's related to the proximity of knowledge or what lies beneath it.
source_quote: My head had been complaining since we arrived at Candlekeep. The proximity — to the knowledge, or to whatever sat underneath the knowledge — was producing a friction I had been mis-attributing to the sun all day.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asks if any of the tomes might help with his headache, revealing his immediate concern is physical discomfort over intellectual curiosity.
source_quote: Can I see or read any of… do any of them… I'm… at this point, my headache… my headache's been bothering me. Is there anything on any of the tomes that might help me with my headache?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz chooses to tell the truth about his amnesia and past instead of using the manipulative tactics common in Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: I told her the truth. "I have a headache, but I'll tell you the story. This is the short version. I don't have much memory before being locked up with a few people in a jail. Because some spider thing was, like, trying to keep us. And we've made an escape. We were in the Underdark. We've had many, many adventures, yada yada yada. Now I'm here in Candlekeep. My head hurts a little bit, and I don't know who I am, or my history, and I don't know why my head hurts."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realizes he has internalized the grammar of Menzoberranzan’s political structure, even if he can’t recall its facts.
source_quote: I knew most of this. Not as facts retrieved from memory, but as grammar. The language you learn to think in before you learn to question it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wonders if he is the "blithering idiot" survivor of the destroyed house, directly connecting his amnesia to the lore.
source_quote: I asked the second logical question. "Am I the blithering idiot?"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has been unconsciously auditing social debts and knowledge networks since before he could name it, a skill ingrained by Menzoberranzan’s training.
source_quote: The first thing Menzoberranzan trains you for is the ledger. Who owes whom, who knows what, who has already lost and hasn't noticed. I have been running that audit unconsciously since before I could name it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices when a word doesn't fit, a training from Menzoberranzan that feels increasingly important to him.
source_quote: The second thing Menzoberranzan trains you for — and this one is equally useful but considerably less comfortable — is to notice when a word doesn't fit.
